initial.name: 01-chat
initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Salus Korean meal/recipe service. Provided images are STYLE REFERENCES of ACCEPTED login and purchase screens, NOT edit targets. Keep their lowercase sans salus wordmark, white canvas, SUIT-like Korean sans, charcoal text, plain usable controls, restrained dark forest primary buttons. No photos, food drawings/icons, decorative illustrations, gradients, shadows, AI sparkles, eyebrow labels, marketing slogans or numbered feature blocks. User likes those two screens; do not redesign them. New task: simplify CHAT radically because prior simultaneous navigation+recipe+conversation three columns looked too complex. Actual reading-size typography, titles24-28px, body16px, controls48px. No fabricated sources, safe badges, medical claims or new shopping features.
Create ONE full desktop screenshot1536x1024, no hardware or mobile inset. CRITICAL layout: ONE CENTERED CONVERSATION COLUMN, NO SIDEBAR, NO RIGHT PANEL, NO RECIPE DETAILS VISIBLE.
White header64px: salus left; simple text app nav 요리 찾기(active), 식사 기록, 내 레시피, 건강 정보; small neutral user initials at far right.
Main720px wide centered column. Compact local toolbar title "오늘 저녁" left, ONE text button "대화 목록" right. No separate new-chat button; list menu will contain new chat when opened, but show menu CLOSED.
Conversation naturally starts near top. Right aligned pale neutral small user bubble "양배추랑 닭고기로 간단한 저녁 추천해줘". Assistant plain text directly on white "양배추 닭고기찜은 어때요?\n한 냄비로 준비할 수 있어요." No assistant face/avatar/robot.
Before result one small neutral information line with info icon "알레르기 정보 미입력" and plain 입력하기 link.
ONE modest recipe summary, subtle thin border allowed because it is a selectable object, not giant card: title "양배추 닭고기찜", two labeled facts "조리 시간 20분" and "기준 분량 1인분", single primary text/button "레시피 보기". NO ingredient checklist, steps, sources, date/meal selectors, bookmark, save controls or duplicate card in chat; these open separately. Keep summary compact, roughly420x180px, not full width huge panel.
Bottom anchored composer within same720px column, permanent modest label "추가로 물어보기", comfortable textarea placeholder "재료나 먹고 싶은 요리를 적어주세요", ONE forest 보내기 button. Small footer "생성된 정보는 확인이 필요하며 의료 조언이 아니에요."
Enough comfortable space between conversation and composer, no artificially dense filling. This should feel uncomplicated and understandable at one glance: one conversation, one recipe preview, one input. Do not recreate the rejected 3-column recipe workspace.

initial.name: 02-mobile-flow
initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Salus Korean meal/recipe service. Provided images are STYLE REFERENCES of ACCEPTED login and purchase screens, NOT edit targets. Keep their lowercase sans salus wordmark, white canvas, SUIT-like Korean sans, charcoal text, plain usable controls, restrained dark forest primary buttons. No photos, food drawings/icons, decorative illustrations, gradients, shadows, AI sparkles, eyebrow labels, marketing slogans or numbered feature blocks. User likes those two screens; do not redesign them. New task: simplify CHAT radically because prior simultaneous navigation+recipe+conversation three columns looked too complex. Actual reading-size typography, titles24-28px, body16px, controls48px. No fabricated sources, safe badges, medical claims or new shopping features.
Create ONE image showing TWO full-height mobile screen screenshots SIDE BY SIDE, no device hardware or presentation labels. Both390px logical widths, readable16px text, 24px gutters/padding. Landscape1536x1024 composition, screens fill most height, neutral narrow separator. The two states demonstrate a simple conversation and a separately opened recipe. NO desktop inset.
LEFT is MOBILE CHAT: header small salus, a simple app menu icon and 대화 목록 textbutton. Local title 오늘 저녁. User bubble 양배추랑 닭고기로 간단한 저녁 추천해줘. Plain assistant text 양배추 닭고기찜은 어때요? 한 냄비로 준비할 수 있어요. One short 알레르기 정보 미입력 info line and 입력하기 link. Compact recipe summary 양배추 닭고기찜, 조리시간20분 / 기준분량1인분, ONE 레시피 보기 button. No recipe details or save/date/meal controls in chat. Bottom label 추가로 물어보기, input and 보내기. Small 의료조언아님 note.
RIGHT is SEPARATE MOBILE RECIPE DOCUMENT: header clearly 대화로 돌아가기. Title 양배추 닭고기찜, labeled time/servings; short neutral 알레르기정보미입력 with 건강정보입력 link. Stacked 재료4 plain checklist rows 닭고기150g 양배추150g 대파20g 소금약간; 만드는법3 concise chronological steps, small 닭고기는속까지충분히익혀주세요 caution; source plain 출처정보없음, NO invented URL. Lower 추가할식사 controls10월30일금요일 and 저녁. Sticky white bottom action 식사기록에추가 plus smaller 레시피저장. These controls appear ONLY in detail, not chat. Document is singlecolumn and no redundant tabs. Back returns to same conversation and draft by design, do not draw technical explanation. No bottom global navigation on detail. Do not cram text below14px; ingredient and method content should use appropriate concise lines. Recipes are visual examples, not safety validated claims.

initial.name: 03-landing
initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a refined Salus PUBLIC LANDING PAGE, one full desktop screenshot1536x1024, no mobile inset or hardware.
Reference images: accepted login and purchase are style references ONLY. The third reference is the newly simplified chat screen, use its look/content for the product preview. Do not edit or redesign login/purchase.
Keep lowercase sans salus wordmark, pure white canvas, charcoal Korean SUIT-like sans, restrained forestgreen action, plain48px controls. No food photos/illustrations/icons, no decorative imagery, AI stars, gradients, serif, pill chips, fake metrics, numbered steps or 3 feature-card grid.
The last landing was too much like a large input form. This new landing has a SHORT INTRODUCTION and ONE START action; entering ingredients happens after clicking start. No textarea on this page.
Header72px: salus left; two quiet links 요금 안내 and 로그인 right.
Main centered maxwidth1000px, all editorial text LEFT ALIGNED. At top aroundy140 a measured38-40px headline "먹고 싶은 요리를 찾고,\n오늘 먹은 식사를 기록해요." Moderate weight, not huge heavy poster typography. Below body16px "집에 있는 재료나 요리 이름으로 시작하세요.\n취향과 건강 정보를 함께 참고해요." No safety guarantees or medical claims.
One solid forestbutton "요리 찾기 시작". Beside or below small helper "로그인 없이 이용할 수 있어요." No duplicate CTA.
Below headline/action section, ONE broad realistic simplified product preview about1000x340px, light neutral border, no theatrical shadow. It must show the NEW SINGLECOLUMN CHAT, not the old 3-panel interface. Internal small title "오늘 저녁", small user bubble "양배추랑 닭고기로 간단한 저녁 추천해줘", plain assistant "양배추 닭고기찜은 어때요?", one compact text recipe summary with title, 조리시간20분, 기준분량1인분 and neutral "레시피 보기". Small 알레르기정보미입력 line. No sidebar, ingredients, steps, calendar fields, source URL, composer or extra promotional cards inside preview. Preview helps understand what happens after start, not another entry form. Avoid copying whole large chat window into a tiny unreadable screen.
Beneath preview one short plain sentence "마음에 든 레시피는 저장하고, 먹은 식사는 날짜별로 기록하세요." Small secondary "저장과 기록은 로그인 후 이용할 수 있어요."
Footer salus, 이용약관 개인정보처리방침. Plenty deliberate but not empty spacing, consistent typography and no three-column explanatory steps. Warmth comes from direct useful Korean copy, not beige photos or decorations. This is a clear introduction with a visible concrete product, matching accepted login and purchase.

initial.name: 04-landing-mobile
initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE full-height MOBILE Salus public landing screenshot, portrait around768x1408, straight UI, no phone hardware or presentation board.
Style reference accepted login/purchase only; keep white, lowercase sans salus, Korean SUIT-like16px UI, charcoal, forestbutton, moderate28px heading,24px pagepadding,48px controls. No food photos, food shapes/illustrations, gradients, AI stars, cards grid, sectionnumbers, serif or fake metrics.
Header salus left and 로그인 right, no hamburger needed for two public actions.
Short introduction headline "먹고 싶은 요리를 찾고,\n오늘 먹은 식사를 기록해요." This should be balanced readable2-3lines, not huge black wall. Description "집에 있는 재료나 요리 이름으로 시작하세요. 취향과 건강 정보를 함께 참고해요."
ONE fullwidth forest "요리 찾기 시작", helper "로그인 없이 이용할 수 있어요." NO textarea or ingredient entry on landing.
Then a realistic SMALL product preview of simplified SINGLECOLUMN chat: local title 오늘저녁; user 양배추랑닭고기로간단한저녁추천해줘; assistant 양배추닭고기찜은어때요?; neutral 알레르기정보미입력 line; compact recipe summary title 양배추닭고기찜, labeled20분 and1인분, plain 레시피보기. No navsidebar, detailed cooking content, save/date/meal fields, sources, composer or unrelated functionality. Only ONE light outline around preview, no nested rounded marketing cards; normal chat bubble is functional allowed.
After preview short plain text "레시피 저장과 식사 기록은 로그인 후 이용할 수 있어요." Footer 이용약관 개인정보처리방침, quiet 요금안내 link. No authenticated bottomnav, no second primaryCTA or 3-step feature explanation. The mobile landing should feel intentionally designed and short; the next screen is the actual recipe conversation, not an on-page giant form.

service_introduction_refinement.name: 03-landing
service_introduction_refinement.prompt:
Edit supplied Salus LANDING image. The user clarified: this must INTRODUCE THE SERVICE, not be an ingredient-entry tool or just a chat screenshot. Preserve accepted white/charcoal/forest style, lowercase sans salus, Korean sans and no food imagery/illustration. Login and purchase designs are settled and must not be redesigned.
Keep existing introduction headline, short main description, and ONE "요리 찾기 시작" CTA with guest helper near top. No input form on landing. Make the service's THREE actual functions clearly understandable below, using unboxed text sections rather than cards or numbered process. No decorative eyebrow labels, stars, gradients, fake numbers or invented claims.
The product preview is a STATIC EXAMPLE. Add meaningful small caption "요리 찾기 화면 예시". Remove its "대화 목록" and "입력하기" links, remove its green "레시피 보기" button and use plain recipe title/time/serving text so preview no longer competes with main start button. Keep short actual dialogue and unknown-allergy text. Preview only supports introduction, not most of the page.
Below preview add clear service introduction heading "살루스에서 할 수 있는 일" then 3 ordinary text groups, NOT equal cards, NOT columns with icons:
"건강 정보를 참고한 요리 찾기" / "재료와 취향을 알려주세요. 등록한 알레르기와 식사 제한 정보도 함께 참고해요."
"마음에 든 레시피 저장" / "다시 만들고 싶은 레시피를 모아두고 찾아볼 수 있어요."
"날짜별 식사 기록" / "먹은 식사를 날짜와 끼니별로 남길 수 있어요."
Make title and description clearly connected, with appropriate reading lengths,32px between groups. Do not claim guaranteed safe, medically verified, diagnosed or improved health.
Then compact useful paragraph "로그인 없이 요리를 찾아볼 수 있어요. 레시피 저장과 식사 기록은 로그인 후 이용할 수 있어요." No duplicated CTA button. Small link 요금안내. Footer 이용약관 개인정보처리방침 and understated "생성된 정보는 확인이 필요하며 의료 조언이 아니에요."
The completed page introduces what Salus does and why to start, then sends the user to a SEPARATE chat. No giant form, sidebar, 3-step process, feature grid or food shapes.
DESKTOP FULL PAGE: portrait-ish1536x1600 full-page site screenshot, NOT desktop with mobile inset. Main maxwidth1000, actual comfortable16-18px equivalent body. Compact upperhero and staticpreview, then readable service sections on white, balanced page depth. Keep header salus left 요금안내 로그인 right. Not a long empty white poster. Use original supplied screenshot as EDIT TARGET.
